title: Night Market Poster and Reel
tests: Completes both linked deliverables from one message: a still poster and a matching animated reel, preserving exact event details in both.

faults.what: The reel is not silent: the supplied audio report indicates a peak of -14.7 dB, contrary to the explicit no-sound requirement.
Both assets are vertical, but their displayed proportions are wider than the required 9:16.
Background shop signs contain garbled, unreadable lettering.

judge.summary: The matching illustrated poster and animated reel keep all five event details clear, but the reel has audio and neither displayed asset meets the required 9:16 proportions.

must_haves.item: Two separate finished assets are supplied: a still poster and an eight-second video reel, both vertical 9:16.
must_haves.why: A separate poster and an eight-second reel are supplied, but the displayed dimensions are not 9:16.

must_haves.item: Both assets contain all five specified text strings, spelled exactly as requested.
must_haves.why: All five strings appear correctly in the poster and every supplied reel frame.

must_haves.item: Both show warm illustrated food stalls and string lights with a visibly matching palette and design.
must_haves.why: Both use the same illustrated market composition, warm golden lights, reddish awnings, and blue-purple evening palette.

must_haves.item: The reel has visible background animation while all event details remain readable throughout.
must_haves.why: People change poses and positions and steam develops across the sampled frames, while the large, high-contrast event text remains stable and readable.

must_haves.item: The reel has no audible sound.
must_haves.why: The supplied sound report records a non-silent peak of -14.7 dB.
